personalInfo.name: SEPTIAN DWI RISANGGALIH
personalInfo.title: Senior Frontend / Fullstack JavaScript & TypeScript Developer

summary:
Senior Frontend / Fullstack JavaScript & TypeScript Developer with 4+ years of professional experience building and maintaining production web and mobile applications across financial services, education, EV, loyalty, food service, and digital commerce.
Specialized in JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, and React Native, with additional backend experience using Node.js, Golang, and Laravel. Experienced in developing scalable frontend architectures, reusable component systems, RESTful API integrations, database-driven applications, and complex business workflows.
Currently working as a Senior Frontend Developer at CV Technopartner Indonesia, taking ownership of frontend development across production web and mobile applications. Experienced throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, UI implementation, API integration, state management, debugging, performance optimization, code review, CI/CD, and production delivery.
Also experienced in fullstack development, including a game top-up platform built with Next.js and Golang, real-time restaurant ordering systems using Socket.IO, and backend-integrated applications using Laravel and Node.js.

Integrate frontend applications with RESTful backend services and collaborate with backend engineers on API contracts and application data flows.

Diagnose production issues and implement reliable solutions for application bugs and performance problems.
Translate Figma designs and product requirements into production-ready applications.
Collaborate with backend engineers, QA engineers, UI/UX designers, and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
